$comment: AGE-1095. Verbatim mirror of VibeWebAgent/scripts/status/endpoints.json (private repo) -- the single canonical endpoint registry both the oncall-health-sweep.yml cron and this public status page consume. scripts/generate-status.mjs in THIS repo reads this file directly (not a separate hardcoded list), and VibeWebAgent's CI runs a parity check (tests/unit/issue-1095-status-page-parity.test.js) that fetches this exact file over the public unauthenticated GitHub raw URL and fails if it drifts from the private registry -- so this can never silently go stale. tee_attestation is deliberately absent: AGE-1053 delisted TEE/Confidential Mode from the shipped product.
